remarks: 198 Hemlock Hill Road, New Canaan, CT.  Perfectly blending classic charm with high-end amenities, this home offers a private summer escape, just moments from the heart of town on desirable Hemlock Hill.  Enjoy 2.5 acres of sweeping lawns and secluded pool. This special property offers many lovely outdoor spaces to enjoy, the inviting covered porch, complete with Adirondack chairs and dining, convenient stone terrace with wood burning fire pit and of course, poolside relaxation. This private pool retreat features a seasonal changing cabana with outdoor shower, half bath and laundry facilities. Warmth and charm welcome you indoors. The well appointed kitchen and family room are open and inviting, the nucleus of this home. A sunny breakfast nook and fireplace complete this gathering space. Four additional fireplaces, including the private wood panelled study, library, living room and primary suite.  The primary suite has tray ceilings, door to deck, lovely bath and a handsome fireplace. There are 3 additional bedrooms (one ensuite) and two baths on the second floor. On the third floor, two more delightful bedrooms and bath, ideal for guests or a quiet getaway.   Enjoy a peaceful summer in New Canaan on Hemlock Hill!
